page.overview:
Who is Atka?

Originally an Earth Kingdom healer, Atka was mentally broken when her entire home village was wiped out by the Northern Pox. Consumed with endless hatred for the people of the Northern Water Tribe capital Agna Qel'a who had refused to provide medical aid to Atka's people, she became determined to single-handedly wipe out the city. To do so, she became the assassin of Minister Huaji of Omashu, thereby acquiring special ingredients to craft a spirit-infused poison. After years of murderous tests in the Northern Water Tribe's hinterlands, Atka unleashed her poison in Agna Qel'a in 63 BG, killing many people including Chief Tiguaa. However, her rampage was stopped by Avatar Roku's team.

Originally born at a poor village in the Earth Kingdom under a different name, while staying very close to her family. Atka also had a boyfriend whom she wished to marry. Besides her medical activities, she trained her earthbending to some degree.

Her life was upended when traders accidentally infected her village with the Northern Pox, an extremely deadly disease. Even though Atka proved to be immune to the illness, the rest of the villagers began to waste away. The healer knew that a remedy for this pox existed, horded by the Northern Water Tribe which controlled the ingredients' supply. The healer ventured to the tribe's capital of Agna Qel'a and pleaded her case before Chief Tiguaa and his council. The Northerners were unmoved, however, as many settlements suffered under the pox and the remedy was valuable. As Atka could not offer enough money for even a few doses of the medicine, she was turned away.

Atka returned to her village and continued to care for her people, but without the remedy she was powerless to stop the pox's progression. Ultimately, her entire family, her boyfriend, her neighbors, and everyone she knew died a slow and gruesome death. In accordance with her village's customs, she individually buried every single villager without earthbending, instead using her bare hands to dig the graves and lay the dead to rest. These experiences resulted in a mental break and a fundamental personality change within Atka; she became consumed by the singular desire to take revenge on Agna Qel'a, the city which had condemned her people to death out of greed.
